name: Our Ancient Enemy
summary: Malah's report has reached Baine Bloodhoof, and his answer is grim. The matter will not go unanswered.

faq.q: What does Baine say about the report?
faq.answer: After reading Malah's report, Baine says the matter will not go unanswered.

faq.q: Who brought the report to Baine?
faq.answer: You bring Malah's report to Baine Bloodhoof.

attribution: In-game quest text: Our Ancient Enemy
